findings.area: wizard step 2 — all six filter triggers
findings.finding: .custom-select-trigger uses justify-content:space-between with three children (label, clear-✕, caret), so the clear-✕ sits at the horizontal centre of the control. document.elementFromPoint(centre of #canton-trigger) returns 'canton-clear'.
findings.fix: Wrap the ✕ and the caret in one right-aligned group (or give the label flex:1), so the centre of the control opens the panel.

findings.finding: .rpt-params-bar and .fa-params-bar are byte-identical declarations (padding 0 20px 12px; flex; wrap; gap 6px; align-items center; background #F5F7FA).
findings.fix: Delete .fa-params-bar and use .rpt-params-bar in the Fahrtausfälle markup.

findings.finding: 109 distinct hex values, 41 of them used exactly once, and two grey systems are mixed: #9CA3AF/#E5E7EB/#374151 (Tailwind-ish) alongside #9E9E9E/#E0E0E0/#424242 (Material). 13 distinct font sizes and 10 distinct border radii.
findings.fix: Pick one grey ramp and one radius/type scale, then replace the one-off values.

findings.finding: Text colours below WCAG AA 4.5:1 on white: #D1D5DB 1.47:1, #BDBDBD 1.88:1, #9CA3AF 2.54:1 (used 40×), #9E9E9E 2.68:1, #10B981 2.54:1, #D97706 3.19:1. Some of these are icon/border uses, but they are declared as `color:`.
findings.fix: Darken the grey used for secondary text to at least #6B7280 (4.8:1) and keep the lighter greys for borders only.
